patterns.note: A fixed left-hand column holds the site logo, while the main content scrolls independently on the right, creating a distinct split-screen experience.
High-contrast black and white forms the base, with a vibrant, often glowing, green used sparingly as a primary accent color.
Prominent text, such as titles and section headers, consistently uses a bold, all-caps sans-serif typeface, creating a strong, direct visual impact.
As the user scrolls, new content sections are revealed, with text elements animating from a very low-contrast, almost invisible state to a bright, high-contrast state.
Content is organized into full-width blocks, often with dark backgrounds, that act as distinct visual modules, each introduced with a scroll-triggered reveal.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed-position element for the left-aligned branding area, allowing the main content on the right to scroll independently beneath it.

Content sections are revealed as the user scrolls, with text elements animating their color or opacity from a subtle, almost invisible state to a prominent, high-contrast state, likely using CSS keyframe animations as detected.
Visuals leverage stark black backgrounds with bright white or glowing green elements to achieve a high-tech, precise, and modern aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, all-caps sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, body text is clean and legible.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between full-width content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its stark, high-contrast aesthetic, combining a fixed left branding column with full-width, scroll-revealed content blocks. The use of glowing green accents against deep black backgrounds creates a precise, almost technical, and very modern feel.
